# Supply-chain planning facts

Safety stock protects against demand and lead-time uncertainty. A basic service-level method combines the target z-score with the standard deviation of demand during replenishment lead time.

The reorder point equals expected demand during lead time plus safety stock. Units and time buckets must be aligned before the calculation.

Supplier lead-time evidence should come from the approved observation window; a planner must not silently substitute an unrelated supplier or obsolete contract.
